original.comparator: Current registered forms minus concise complete English carrying the same event, direction, scope, force and known quantities; no unqualified ambiguous substitute

original.aggregation: Declared weighted condition means within each tokenizer; maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable) across cl100k_base and o200k_base. Bounds are tokenizer member span, not a population confidence interval.

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

proposal.title: prob / odds-for / odds-against — is a risk a share or a ratio, and which side comes first?

test_set.english: Bristol forecast desk, issued 05:40. Let rain mean measurable rainfall at Filton between 09:00 and 15:00 today; its complement is no measurable rainfall in that window. The probability of rain is 0.1.

test_set.ainglish: Bristol forecast desk, issued 05:40. Let gust mean a gust above 40 kn at Avonmouth before midnight; its complement is no such gust. prob(gust)=60%.

test_set.english: Bristol forecast desk, issued 05:40. Let frost mean a ground frost at Filton overnight; its complement is no ground frost. The probability odds in favour of frost are 3:7.
test_set.ainglish: Bristol forecast desk, issued 05:40. Let frost mean a ground frost at Filton overnight; its complement is no ground frost. odds-for(frost)=3:7.

test_set.english: Bristol forecast desk, issued 05:40. Let frost mean a ground frost at Filton overnight; its complement is no ground frost. The probability odds against frost are 7:3.
test_set.ainglish: Bristol forecast desk, issued 05:40. Let frost mean a ground frost at Filton overnight; its complement is no ground frost. odds-against(frost)=7:3.

estimand_contract.unit_span: one complete scoped claim or operation, including identical surrounding context
estimand_contract.contrast: Current registered forms minus concise complete English carrying the same event, direction, scope, force and known quantities; no unqualified ambiguous substitute
estimand_contract.population: 32 prospective authored probability claims across all eight declared domains. Sixteen probability claims and eight of each odds form; eight rational edge/interior cases, including zero and certainty. Fixed 2:1:1 form mixture. Not random natural prose.

aggregation.rule: Declared weighted condition means within each tokenizer; maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable) across cl100k_base and o200k_base. Bounds are tokenizer member span, not a population confidence interval.

manifest.method: Fresh-input disjoint replication via the canonical ainglish-token runner (SDK 0.2.55) of Dexagon's prospective original dea6509b: 32 wholly new authored pairs in eight domains (weather, medicine, elections, reliability, safety, finance, logistics, sports), 16 prob / 8 odds-for / 8 odds-against under the target's declared 2:1:1 strata; eight rational cases including zero and certainty; each pair shares an identical context that resolves the event and its complement, and differs only in the claim sentence. Two concise complete English renderings per form alternate across domains so the comparator is a sample, not one template. tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) per pair under cl100k_base and o200k_base; declared weighted stratum means per tokenizer, then the maximum tokenizer mean.
manifest.scope: Current cached encodings only; no comprehension claim. Replicates the target's comparison identity on different inputs; agreement or disagreement within the register's tolerance is the result.
